*Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa says she has not spoken with Elon Musk but is open to working with him after he described her as “quite moderate” and predicted she would be “fine” as governor.*

• *Musk:* Hinojosa acknowledged his significant business interests in Texas and said cooperation must benefit Texans.
• *Political Identity:* Asked whether she is a moderate, Hinojosa rejected ideological labels, saying, “If I had to label myself, I'd call myself an economic populist.”
• *Corporate Influence:* She argued that corporate interests have corrupted both political parties and called for leaders who prioritize constituents over corporate pressure.
• *Economic Priorities:* Hinojosa said Texas can maintain a strong business community, but its economy must serve residents first.
